name: Test after a climax
idea: After stopping volume or a climax at the end of a fall, a signal on the first test: a down bar into the climax area on lower volume closing high. The mirror: after a climax at the end of a rise or an up-thrust, an up bar with no demand. Wrong beyond the extreme since the climax.

params.label: Bars from the climax to the test
params.help: The test or no-demand bar must come within this many bars of the climax, stopping volume or up-thrust. Reference: 20.

params.label: Bars for the average
params.help: Each bar's spread and volume are measured against the average of this many bars before it. Reference: 20.

params.label: Narrow spread below
params.help: A spread below this multiple of the average range is narrow. Reference: 0.7.

params.label: Wide spread above
params.help: A spread above this multiple of the average range is wide. Reference: 1.3.

params.label: Ultra-wide spread above
params.help: A spread above this multiple of the average range is ultra-wide. Reference: 2.

params.label: High volume above
params.help: Volume above this multiple of the average is high. Reference: 1.3.

params.label: Ultra-high volume above
params.help: Volume above this multiple of the average is ultra-high. Reference: 2.

params.label: Close position part
params.help: The close is in the low third below this share of the bar's range and in the high third above one minus it. Reference: a third.

params.label: Bars for lower volume
params.help: Lower volume means lower than each of this many bars before. Reference: 2.

params.label: Bars for new highs or lows
params.help: Highs or lows beyond this many bars before are new ground. Reference: 20.

params.label: Bars for the structure before
params.help: These bars against as many before them: a higher high and higher low is rising, a lower high and lower low is falling. Reference: 10.

params.label: Bars for the background
params.help: A climax within this many bars before counts for the background. Reference: 20.

params.label: Bars searched for the climax area
params.help: The test reaches the range of a high-volume bar within this many bars before. Reference: 20.

params.label: Nearness to that area
params.help: How near that bar's range the low must come, in average ranges. Reference: 0.25.

params.label: Only with the structure before
params.help: Count each reading only with the structure before it that the reading needs (a fall before a climax at the end of a fall, and so on).

params.label: Next-bar confirmation
params.help: Each reading counts on the next bar, only when that bar closes higher (strength) or lower (weakness).

constraints.message: The narrow limit must be below the wide one.
The wide limit must be below the ultra-wide one.
The high-volume limit must be below the ultra-high one.
The bars for lower volume must be at most the bars for the average.

setup.long: VSA("stopping_volume", n=$n, narrow=$narrow, wide=$wide, ultra=$ultra, vol_high=$vol_high, vol_ultra=$vol_ultra, part=$part, prev=$prev, new_bars=$new_bars, trend_bars=$trend_bars, bg_bars=$bg_bars, area_bars=$area_bars, area_tol=$area_tol, background=$background, confirm=$confirm) OR VSA("selling_climax", n=$n, narrow=$narrow, wide=$wide, ultra=$ultra, vol_high=$vol_high, vol_ultra=$vol_ultra, part=$part, prev=$prev, new_bars=$new_bars, trend_bars=$trend_bars, bg_bars=$bg_bars, area_bars=$area_bars, area_tol=$area_tol, background=$background, confirm=$confirm)
setup.short: VSA("buying_climax", n=$n, narrow=$narrow, wide=$wide, ultra=$ultra, vol_high=$vol_high, vol_ultra=$vol_ultra, part=$part, prev=$prev, new_bars=$new_bars, trend_bars=$trend_bars, bg_bars=$bg_bars, area_bars=$area_bars, area_tol=$area_tol, background=$background, confirm=$confirm) OR VSA("up_thrust", n=$n, narrow=$narrow, wide=$wide, ultra=$ultra, vol_high=$vol_high, vol_ultra=$vol_ultra, part=$part, prev=$prev, new_bars=$new_bars, trend_bars=$trend_bars, bg_bars=$bg_bars, area_bars=$area_bars, area_tol=$area_tol, background=$background, confirm=$confirm)

trigger.long: VSA("test", n=$n, narrow=$narrow, wide=$wide, ultra=$ultra, vol_high=$vol_high, vol_ultra=$vol_ultra, part=$part, prev=$prev, new_bars=$new_bars, trend_bars=$trend_bars, bg_bars=$bg_bars, area_bars=$area_bars, area_tol=$area_tol, background=$background, confirm=$confirm)
trigger.short: VSA("no_demand", n=$n, narrow=$narrow, wide=$wide, ultra=$ultra, vol_high=$vol_high, vol_ultra=$vol_ultra, part=$part, prev=$prev, new_bars=$new_bars, trend_bars=$trend_bars, bg_bars=$bg_bars, area_bars=$area_bars, area_tol=$area_tol, background=$background, confirm=$confirm)
